exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: Bodyweight pushing exercise performed face-down. Lower chest to floor and press back up. Requires full-body tension to maintain a rigid plank position.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lying flat on a bench, press a barbell from chest to lockout. Back and body are fully supported by the bench â€” load comes from the bar, not bodyweight against gravity.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Same as barbell bench press but with dumbbells, allowing greater range of motion and independent arm movement. Body is fully supported by bench.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Barbell press on an inclined bench (30-45 degrees). The incline shifts emphasis to the upper chest and dramatically increases anterior deltoid recruitment compared to flat bench.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Military Press)
exercises.description: Standing barbell press from shoulder level to full lockout overhead. Full-body stability required â€” loading is vertical and against gravity throughout the lift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Seated or standing dumbbell press from shoulder height to overhead. Independent arms allow natural wrist rotation. Can be seated (supported) or standing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Lying flat on a bench with arms wide, arc dumbbells together over chest. Isolates chest via a long lever arm â€” high stretch under load at the bottom position.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description: Parallel bar dip with a forward torso lean to emphasize the chest over triceps. Full bodyweight loaded against gravity â€” demanding on the anterior shoulder.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides from hip level to shoulder height. Isolates the lateral deltoid for shoulder width. High rotator cuff stress at top of range.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Pull a cable rope attachment toward the face with elbows high. Targets rear deltoids and external rotators â€” essential for rotator cuff health and posture correction.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.description: Standing at a cable machine, push a bar or rope downward to full elbow extension. Isolates the triceps with minimal shoulder involvement.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Lying Tricep Extension)
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, lower a barbell or EZ-bar toward the forehead by bending elbows, then extend back up. Long-head tricep emphasis. Body is fully supported.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or cable overhead with both hands, lower behind head by bending elbows, then extend. Maximally stretches the long head of the tricep.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull until chin clears the bar. Full bodyweight pulled against gravity â€” one of the best lat and bicep developers.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Seated at a cable machine, pull a wide bar down to upper chest. Same muscles as pull-up but seated and fully supported â€” adjustable load makes it accessible at all levels.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-over Row
exercises.description: Hinge forward with a barbell, pull it to the lower chest/upper abdomen. High erector and lumbar demand to maintain position. Excellent compound back builder.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: Brace one hand and knee on a bench, row a dumbbell with the other arm. Unilateral â€” allows heavier load per side and reduces lumbar stress vs. barbell row.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Seated at a low cable pulley, pull a close-grip handle to the abdomen. Controlled resistance curve, low lumbar stress due to upright seated position.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly
exercises.description: Hinge forward with dumbbells, raise arms out to the sides with a slight elbow bend. Isolates the rear deltoids and mid-traps â€” a key postural corrector.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.description: Stand holding a barbell, elevate shoulders toward ears and hold briefly. Isolates the upper trapezius. Heavy loading places significant cervical and lumbar compression.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Standing barbell curl from full elbow extension to full flexion. Bilaterally loads the biceps through a long range of motion. Wrist is fixed in supination.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Dumbbell curl with a neutral (hammer) grip. Heavily recruits the brachialis and brachioradialis alongside the bicep, contributing to overall arm thickness.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: Barbell on upper back, squat until thighs are parallel or below. The king of lower body exercises â€” heavy axial loading through the spine. Quad-dominant with significant glute and hamstring contribution.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.description: Barbell racked on the front deltoids, squat to depth. More upright torso than back squat â€” dramatically increases quad and core demand and reduces lumbar compression. Challenging wrist and shoulder position.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.description: Pull a barbell from the floor to hip lockout. The most total-muscle-mass movement in existence â€” hinge pattern with simultaneous knee extension and hip extension under maximal load.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.description: Start standing, hinge at hips with soft knees, lower barbell along legs until hamstring limit is reached, then drive hips forward. Hamstring-dominant hip hinge â€” less knee bend than conventional deadlift.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Seated in a sled machine, press a weighted platform away with both feet. Body fully supported â€” allows very heavy loading with almost no lumbar involvement. Quad-dominant.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then drive back to start. Can be done with bodyweight, dumbbells, or a barbell. Unilateral â€” challenges balance and hip stabilizers.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height and squat to depth. The counterweight naturally promotes an upright torso and is the best squat teaching tool for beginners.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Upper back on a bench, barbell across hips, drive hips up to full extension. Glute-isolation king â€” back is supported, which removes lumbar shear. Best glute activator by EMG.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
exercises.description: Lying face down on a machine, curl the heel toward the glutes against resistance. Isolates the hamstrings with the body fully supported â€” good for hamstring injury rehab.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: Kneel with feet anchored, slowly lower the body toward the floor by extending knees while bracing the hamstrings eccentrically. Extremely high eccentric hamstring loading.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: Rise on tiptoes against bodyweight or loaded resistance. Isolates the gastrocnemius (and soleus). Standing position preferentially recruits the gastrocnemius over seated.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a push-up position with a rigid body from head to toe. Isometric anti-extension core exercise â€” trains the abs, obliques, and erectors to resist spinal flexion under load.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Lying on back, curl the upper spine off the floor by contracting the abs â€” only the upper back lifts, lower back stays down. Short range of motion rectus abdominis isolation.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise legs to 90 degrees or above. Demands the abs AND hip flexors strongly â€” grip and shoulder endurance are also limiting factors.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Seated with feet raised, rotate torso left and right â€” optionally holding a weight. Primary rotational core exercise targeting the obliques. High lumbar rotation load.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.description: Standing or lying on a bench, pull the cables together in a horizontal arc while keeping elbows slightly bent, emphasizing pectoralis major adduction and scapular protraction.

exercises.name: Close-grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, press a barbell upward from a narrow grip, emphasizing triceps extension while the chest and anterior deltoid assist in the movement.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lying on a decline bench, press dumbbells upward from the lower chest to full lockout. Emphasizes the lower pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps while the bench supports the torso.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Lying on an incline bench, hold dumbbells above chest with arms slightly bent and open arms wide, then bring them together over the upper chest. Emphasizes the clavicular portion of the pectoralis major and anterior deltoid while providing a high shoulder flexion stretch.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Lying on the floor, press a barbell from the chest upward; emphasizes chest, anterior deltoid, and triceps while the floor limits shoulder extension and provides stability.

exercises.name: Svend Press
exercises.description: Lying on the back, press a weight plate held together with both hands outward while keeping elbows slightly bent, emphasizing chest contraction and scapular protraction.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description: Standing with a barbell anchored at one end, press the free end upward and slightly forward. Primarily works the anterior deltoid and triceps while engaging the core, serratus anterior and upper back for spinal stability.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.description: Standing between two cable pulleys, bring the handles together in front of the chest with a slight elbow bend, emphasizing horizontal shoulder adduction to target the pectoralis major while stabilizing the scapulae.

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
exercises.description: Bodyweight pushing exercise performed with feet elevated, increasing load on the upper chest and anterior deltoid while demanding core stability to maintain a straight line.

exercises.name: Archer Push-up
exercises.description: A unilateral push-up with one hand positioned laterally and the other near the torso, loading the chest, anterior deltoid and triceps heavily while demanding core and shoulder stabilisation to resist gravity.

exercises.name: Wide-grip Push-up
exercises.description: Bodyweight push-up performed with hands placed wider than shoulder width, emphasizing horizontal shoulder abduction and chest activation while requiring core stability to resist lumbar compression.

exercises.name: Deficit Push-up
exercises.description: A push-up performed with the hands on an elevated surface, increasing range of motion and loading the chest, anterior deltoid and triceps through a deeper elbow extension while the core stabilizes the spine.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Seated or standing dumbbell press with palms rotating from supinated to pronated as the weight moves overhead, heavily loading the anterior and lateral deltoids while engaging the triceps, rotator cuff, and core for shoulder stability.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine Fly
exercises.description: Seated machine fly that moves the arms horizontally from an abducted to an adducted position, targeting the pectoralis major while the scapulae are stabilized; the movement loads the chest and anterior deltoid against horizontal resistance.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
exercises.description: Lying on a decline bench, press a barbell upward from the lower chest. Primary movers are the pectoralis major and triceps, with anterior deltoid and serratus anterior assisting while core muscles stabilize the torso.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Press dumbbells on an inclined bench (30‑45°). The angle emphasizes the upper chest and anterior deltoid while requiring greater shoulder stabilization compared to a barbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.description: Lying on the floor, press two dumbbells from the chest to full arm extension; the floor limits shoulder range, emphasizing chest and triceps while the body is supported.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Lying on the floor, press dumbbells upward from the chest; primary movers are the pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps, with secondary stabilization from shoulders, forearms, and upper back.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-up
exercises.description: A bodyweight push-up variation where hands are placed close together under the chest forming a diamond shape, placing high mechanical tension on the triceps and inner chest while demanding anti-extension core stability.

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.description: A bodyweight pressing variation where the body is held in an inverted V-position, shifting resistance overhead to target the anterior deltoids, upper pectorals, and triceps.

exercises.name: Wall Push-up
exercises.description: A low-impact bodyweight pressing movement performed at an incline against a wall, engaging the pectoralis major, anterior deltoids, and triceps with minimal joint shear.

exercises.name: Clapping Push-up
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric push-up variation that recruits fast-twitch muscle fibers in the chest, anterior deltoids, and triceps to launch the upper body off the floor, requiring high rate of force development and rapid core stabilization.

exercises.name: Pseudo-planche Push-up
exercises.description: An advanced bodyweight pressing variation where hands are positioned back near the waist, shifting the body forward to place immense torque and demand on the anterior deltoids, chest, and serratus anterior.

exercises.name: Ring Push-up
exercises.description: A bodyweight horizontal pushing movement performed on gymnastic rings that heavily targets the chest, triceps, and anterior deltoids while requiring immense shoulder stability and core tightness.

exercises.name: Spiderman Push-up
exercises.description: A bodyweight push-up variation where one knee is drawn toward the ipsilateral elbow during descent, combining horizontal pressing with unilateral hip flexion and core rotation.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A compound overhead pressing movement performed while seated that primarily targets the anterior and lateral deltoids and triceps with reduced lower-back strain compared to standing variations.

exercises.name: Z-Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: An overhead press variation performed seated on the floor with legs extended, which eliminates lower-body drive and forces extreme core stability, thoracic extension, and shoulder strength.

exercises.name: Push Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: A dynamic compound overhead press that uses a rapid leg dip and drive to launch the barbell overhead, targeting the shoulders, triceps, and lower body.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise where a barbell is drawn upward along the torso, heavily targeting the lateral deltoids and upper trapezius through shoulder abduction and scapular elevation.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise where dumbbells are pulled along the front of the body to shoulder level, driving shoulder abduction and scapular elevation to target the lateral deltoids and upper trapezius.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise targeting the lateral deltoid using a low cable pulley to maintain continuous tension throughout glenohumeral abduction.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An upper-body isolation exercise targeting the anterior deltoid and upper chest through shoulder flexion against gravity.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
exercises.description: A shoulder isolation movement that targets the anterior deltoids through shoulder flexion against gravity, while requiring isometric stabilization from the core and upper back.

exercises.name: Plate Front Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise that targets the anterior deltoids and clavicular head of the pectoralis major through shoulder flexion in the sagittal plane while resisting momentum and spinal extension.

exercises.name: Leaning Lateral Raise
exercises.description: A single-arm dumbbell lateral raise variation performed while leaning sideways away from a support post. This alters the resistance profile to maximize mechanical tension on the lateral deltoid at the initial stretch position of shoulder abduction.

exercises.name: Incline Push-up
exercises.description: A compound pushing exercise performed with hands elevated on a stable surface, targeting the chest, anterior deltoids, and triceps while reducing relative load compared to a standard push-up.

exercises.name: Seated Behind-the-Neck Press
exercises.description: An overhead press variation performed with a barbell behind the neck from a seated position, heavily recruiting the anterior and lateral deltoids and triceps while placing extreme demands on shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
exercises.description: An upper body pulling exercise emphasizing the lateral deltoids and upper trapezius as the cable pulley provides constant vertical and horizontal resistance.

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable pulley to target the anterior deltoids, providing continuous tension throughout the shoulder flexion range of motion while minimizing the momentum seen with free weights.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing cables to target the posterior deltoids and upper back muscles through horizontal abduction of the shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Band Pull-apart
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling movement targeting the posterior shoulders and upper back musculature. Recruits the rhomboids, posterior deltoids, and mid-traps to retract and stabilize the scapulae against the elastic resistance of the band.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise using a resistance band targeting the upper back and rear deltoids to improve posture and shoulder health.

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
exercises.description: An upper body exercise performed face down on an incline or flat bench, lifting arms in a 'Y' shape against gravity. It heavily targets the lower and middle traps, posterior deltoids, and rotator cuff to improve scapular retraction and shoulder health.

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
exercises.description: An upper body exercise performed lying face down, targeting the posterior shoulder and mid-back musculature by horizontally abducting the arms. It effectively engages the posterior deltoids, rhomboids, and middle traps to improve scapular retraction and shoulder health.

exercises.name: Prone W Raise
exercises.description: An upper body exercise performed face down on a bench or the floor, targeting the mid-traps, rhomboids, and rotator cuff through scapular retraction and external rotation in a W-arm position.

exercises.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
exercises.description: A variation of the lateral raise performed by holding the sleeve of a landmine-anchored barbell and raising it in an arc, providing a variable resistance profile that heavily targets the lateral deltoids.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.description: An upper-body push exercise performed on a seated machine that primarily targets the anterior deltoids and triceps through shoulder flexion and elbow extension.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise using a machine to target the lateral deltoids by abducting the arms against constant resistance, minimizing stabilization demands from other muscle groups.

exercises.name: Machine Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed on a reverse deck machine that targets the posterior deltoids and upper back musculature by moving the arms horizontally away from the midline against resistance.

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed in a bent-over position where the elbow is locked in place and the forearm extends backward against gravity, maximizing tension on the triceps brachii.

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback (Cable)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with a cable pulley targeting the triceps brachii through elbow extension against horizontal resistance.

exercises.name: Close-grip Push-up
exercises.description: A compound pushing exercise performed with hands placed closer than shoulder-width, emphasizing elbow extension to heavily target the triceps alongside the chest and anterior deltoids.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip (Bench)
exercises.description: A bodyweight pressing movement targeting the triceps and anterior deltoids, performed with hands elevated on a bench behind the body. It relies on elbow extension against gravity while placing high stress on the shoulder and elbow joints.

exercises.name: Ring Dip
exercises.description: An advanced upper-body pushing exercise performed on gymnastics rings, requiring exceptional stabilization of the pectoral and triceps muscle groups against gravity while the rings demand high rotator cuff and core activation.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with a cable pulley set high, targeting the triceps brachii through shoulder flexion to emphasize the long head.

exercises.name: EZ-bar Skull Crusher
exercises.description: An isolation exercise targeting the triceps through elbow extension while lying supine on a bench, utilizing an EZ-curl bar to reduce wrist strain.

exercises.name: Tate Press
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed lying on a bench where dumbbells are pressed upward while keeping elbows flared, placing intense tension on the triceps through elbow extension.

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.description: A hybrid compound movement combining a close-grip bench press and a triceps extension, heavily targeting the triceps and anterior deltoids through elbow extension under heavy load.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (Rope)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with a cable machine where elbow extension is resisted, heavily targeting the triceps brachii with the rope allowing for enhanced terminal wrist pronation and lateral head engagement.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (V-bar)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with a cable machine and V-bar attachment, targeting the triceps brachii through elbow extension against horizontal-vertical cable resistance.

exercises.name: Single-arm Cable Tricep Extension
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable machine to target the triceps brachii through elbow extension. The constant tension of the cable ensures high recruitment throughout the entire range of motion.

exercises.name: Machine Tricep Extension
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed on a machine to target the triceps brachii through elbow extension while keeping the upper arms stabilized.

exercises.name: T-bar Row
exercises.description: A compound horizontal pull exercise utilizing a landmine setup to target the lats, rhomboids, and mid-traps while heavily engaging the erector spinae for isometric stabilization.

exercises.name: Chest-supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise performed with the torso braced against an inclined bench, which eliminates momentum and lumbar spine stress while targeting the lats, rhomboids, and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Chest-supported Barbell Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise performed with the chest braced against a bench to eliminate momentum, targeting the lats, rhomboids, and traps while minimizing lumbar spine loading.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.description: A dynamic barbell row variation initiated from a dead stop on the floor in a parallel-to-the-ground torso position, emphasizing explosive upper back, lat, and erector spinae recruitment.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.description: An asymmetric single-arm landmine rowing variation popularized by John Meadows that targets the upper back, lats, and posterior deltoids through a unique pulling angle.

exercises.name: Single-arm Cable Row
exercises.description: A unilateral horizontal pulling exercise that targets the lats, rhomboids, and mid-traps while challenging rotational core stability against the cable's pull.

exercises.name: Straight-arm Pulldown
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with a cable stack that targets the latissimus dorsi through shoulder extension while keeping the elbows locked. It heavily recruits the lats and teres major without engaging the elbow flexors.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling movement targeting the posterior deltoids and upper back musculature. By utilizing cables, continuous tension is applied throughout the transverse extension of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Wide-grip Pull-up
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise emphasizing the latissimus dorsi and teres major through enhanced shoulder adduction, while engaging the mid-back and biceps to elevate the body.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.description: A vertical pulling movement targeting the latissimus dorsi and biceps brachii by drawing the chin over a fixed bar using a supinated grip.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip Pull-up
exercises.description: A compound vertical pulling exercise performed with palms facing each other, heavily targeting the latissimus dorsi and biceps brachii while demanding strong scapular stabilizer engagement against gravity.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-up
exercises.description: An advanced compound upper-body pulling movement where an external load is suspended from the body to increase resistance. It primarily targets the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and biceps while requiring significant core and scapular stabilization.

exercises.name: Ring Pull-up
exercises.description: An advanced upper body pulling exercise performed on gymnastics rings, challenging the lats, upper back, and biceps while requiring exceptional core and scapular stability due to the unstable nature of the rings.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling movement targeting the upper back and lats while strengthening the scapular retractors. It relies on bodyweight against gravity in a semi-supine or horizontal plane.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.description: A partial deadlift variation performed from elevated pins or blocks that emphasizes the lockout phase, heavily loading the erector spinae, glutes, and upper back while reducing knee flexion demands.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip-hinge variation utilizing a wide stance and a narrow grip to emphasize the quadriceps, adductors, and glutes while reducing lumbar shear through a more upright torso.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.description: A compound lower-body exercise utilizing a hexagonal bar to allow a more upright torso, heavily recruiting the quads and glutes while minimizing lumbar shear stress compared to a straight barbell deadlift.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.description: A variation of the conventional deadlift performed while standing on an elevated platform, increasing the range of motion and placing higher demands on knee extension and ankle dorsiflexion. It heavily recruits the posterior chain, particularly the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings, while increasing quadriceps engagement off the floor.

exercises.name: Pause Deadlift
exercises.description: A variation of the traditional deadlift featuring a momentary isometric pause just below the knee to eliminate the stretch-shortening cycle, heavily targeting the posterior chain and lumbar erectors.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement emphasizing eccentric loading of the posterior chain, primarily targeting the hamstrings and glutes while requiring strong isometric stabilization from the erector spinae.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral hip-hinge exercise that challenges single-leg stability while targeting the hamstrings and glutes through an eccentric stretch. The erector spinae and core actively stabilize the spine against rotation and flexion throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed with a barbell across the upper back, heavily targeting the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings through lumbar and hip flexion/extension against gravity.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip Deadlift
exercises.description: A variation of the traditional deadlift utilizing a wide grip, increasing the range of motion and placing greater demands on the upper back, traps, and posterior chain.

exercises.name: Yates Row
exercises.description: A variation of the barbell row performed in a more upright posture with an underhand grip, emphasizing the lats, rhomboids, and mid traps while placing significant loading demands on the lumbar spine and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row (Wide grip)
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling movement targeting the upper back musculature, including the rhomboids, mid traps, and rear deltoids, using a wide overhand grip on a seated machine.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row (Close grip)
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise performed on a seated machine using a close grip, targeting the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and mid-traps while engaging the biceps and posterior deltoids.

exercises.name: Machine Pulldown (Wide grip)
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise performed on a machine targeting the latissimus dorsi and upper back through shoulder adduction and scapular depression. The wide grip emphasizes outer lat development while engaging the rhomboids and biceps as secondary movers.

exercises.name: Machine Pulldown (Neutral grip)
exercises.description: A seated vertical pulling exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi and upper back muscles using a neutral grip to emphasize lat width and thickness while minimizing shoulder external rotation stress.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise performed lying face down on an elevated bench, removing momentum to isolate the upper back and lats.

exercises.name: Helms Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A chest-supported dumbbell row performed on an inclined bench, targeting the lats, rhomboids, and mid-traps while minimizing spinal loading.

exercises.name: Kroc Row
exercises.description: A high-rep, heavy dumbbell row utilizing body momentum and trunk rotation to overload the lats, upper back, and grip strength.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl (Straight bar)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable pulley to provide continuous tension throughout elbow flexion, primarily targeting the biceps brachii and brachialis. The constant vector of the cable ensures loading across the entire range of motion.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl (Rope)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable machine and rope attachment to flex the elbow against constant horizontal tension, heavily targeting the biceps brachii and brachialis while emphasizing the brachioradialis through a neutral grip.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: An elbow flexion exercise performed on an inclined bench that places the shoulder in extension, increasing the stretch on the biceps brachii and maximizing recruitment during the lift.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed seated with the elbow braced against the inner thigh, targeting the biceps brachii and brachialis while minimizing body momentum.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
exercises.description: An isolated elbow flexion exercise performed with arms braced against a slanted pad, maximizing biceps brachii recruitment by eliminating momentum and locking the shoulder in slight flexion.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with the upper arms supported on an inclined bench pad, heavily targeting the biceps brachii while eliminating momentum and restricting shoulder involvement.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description: An isolated biceps curl performed while lying chest-down on an inclined bench, eliminating momentum and maximizing tension on the biceps brachii at the peak of elbow flexion.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
exercises.description: A compound bicep curl variation featuring a supinated upward phase to target the biceps and brachialis, followed by a pronated eccentric phase to heavily recruit the forearms and brachioradialis.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
exercises.description: An elbow-flexion movement performed with a pronated grip that primarily targets the brachialis and brachioradialis, while also recruiting the wrist extensors and biceps brachii.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An elbow flexion exercise performed with a pronated grip, emphasizing the brachioradialis and brachialis while heavily recruiting the forearm extensors and biceps brachii.

exercises.name: Cable Hammer Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable pulley with a rope attachment to target the brachialis, biceps brachii, and brachioradialis with constant tension in a neutral grip.

exercises.name: Cross-body Hammer Curl
exercises.description: A variation of the standard hammer curl where dumbbells are pulled across the torso toward the opposite shoulder, targeting the brachialis and brachioradialis with increased recruitment of the anterior deltoid.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.description: An isolated elbow flexion exercise performed on a machine with the upper arms supported on an angled pad, placing high mechanical demand on the biceps brachii while minimizing momentum.

exercises.name: High Cable Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed with dual high pulleys targeting the biceps brachii, emphasizing the peak contraction phase in shoulder abduction. The brachialis and forearms act as secondary movers while the core stabilizes the torso against the horizontal pull vector.

exercises.name: Single-arm Cable Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable pulley to provide constant tension throughout the elbow flexion movement, primarily targeting the biceps brachii and brachialis.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
exercises.description: A single-leg squat variation performed with a barbell across the upper back, placing high unilateral demand on the quadriceps and glutes while requiring significant core stability and ankle mobility.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral lower-body exercise targeting the quadriceps and glutes through an accentuated split stance with the rear foot elevated. High knee and hip flexion under load demand significant stability from the adductors, hamstrings, and core.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.description: A closed-chain compound lower body exercise performed on a machine sled, targeting the quadriceps and glutes while providing back and torso support.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.description: An advanced bodyweight squat variation that isolates the quadriceps by shifting the hips forward and extending the knees backward. Places significant tension on the knee extensors and requires strong core stability to prevent lumbar hyperextension.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.description: A bilateral lower body exercise performed on a fixed vertical barbell track targeting the quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings with guided stability.

exercises.name: Pause Squat (Barbell)
exercises.description: A variation of the back squat incorporating an isometric hold at the bottom position, which eliminates the stretch-shortening cycle and heavily recruits the quadriceps, glutes, and core to drive out of the hole.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.description: A compound lower body movement where the lifter squats down onto a box before returning to standing, which increases posterior chain engagement and allows for explosive power development from a dead stop.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.description: A variation of the squat where the barbell is held in the crooks of the elbows, placing high demands on the anterior core, upper back, and quads while challenging thoracic extension against gravity.

exercises.name: Safety Bar Squat
exercises.description: A variation of the back squat performed with a specialized cambered safety squat bar that reduces shoulder mobility demands while challenging the upper back, core, and quadriceps through a heavy vertical load.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.description: A squat variation holding the end of a landmine barbell at chest level, emphasizing knee and hip extension against an angled load. Primarily targets the quadriceps and glutes while requiring core and upper back stability.

exercises.name: Step-up (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral lower-body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes through knee and hip extension against gravity while holding dumbbells.

exercises.name: Step-up (Barbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral compound lower-body exercise targeting the quadriceps, glutes, and adductors as you step up onto a box against gravity, requiring significant pelvic and ankle stabilization.

exercises.name: Box Step-up
exercises.description: A unilateral lower body movement focusing on hip and knee extension against gravity, heavily recruiting the quads and glutes while requiring core and ankle stability.

exercises.name: Lateral Step-up
exercises.description: A unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps and glutes by stepping up onto a platform laterally. It heavily recruits the abductors and adductors for frontal plane stability.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral lower body exercise where the lifter steps backward into a lunge, emphasizing knee and hip extension against gravity. Primary recruitment targets the quads and glutes while requiring significant ankle, hip, and core stabilization.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral lower body exercise performed by stepping backward into a lunge while supporting a barbell across the upper back, heavily targeting the quads and glutes while requiring core stability.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A dynamic unilateral lower-body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes through simultaneous hip and knee flexion under external load. The continuous stepping motion challenges dynamic balance, core stability, and single-leg strength.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.description: A dynamic unilateral lower-body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes while requiring significant dynamic stabilization from the core and abductors. The barbell placement across the upper back increases lumbar compression and axial load.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral multi-planar exercise targeting the quads, glutes, and adductors through frontal plane loading. Asymmetrical load places high demands on the stance-leg hip abductors and adductors while eccentrically loading the working quadriceps.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.description: A unilateral multi-planar lower body exercise that targets the gluteus medius and quads while challenging frontal plane stability through a crossed-back stepping motion.

exercises.name: Leg Extension Machine
exercises.description: An isolated seated knee extension exercise targeting the quadriceps against resistance provided by a machine pad. Stresses the knee joint under load as the lower leg extends.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat variation holding a dumbbell vertically, emphasizing hip adductors, glutes, and quadriceps while maintaining an upright torso.

exercises.name: Single-leg Leg Press
exercises.description: A unilateral closed-chain leg exercise performed on a machine, targeting the quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings while requiring significant pelvic stabilization.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.description: A single-leg bodyweight squat requiring high levels of knee and hip flexion under load, demanding exceptional lower body strength, balance, and ankle dorsiflexion mobility.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.description: An isometric compound lower body exercise performed by holding a seated position against a wall, heavily recruiting the quads and glutes while requiring core stability to maintain posture.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric exercise that develops power by rapidly loading and extending the hips, knees, and ankles to propel the body upward onto a box. Primarily targets the quadriceps, glutes, and calves through explosive triple extension.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric variation of the standard squat that emphasizes triple extension at the hips, knees, and ankles to develop lower body power. It intensely recruits the quadriceps, glutes, and calves to overcome bodyweight and gravity during the propulsive phase.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric movement emphasizing horizontal power output through triple extension of the hips, knees, and ankles. Primarily targets the glutes, quads, and calves while requiring intense core and erector stabilization upon landing.

exercises.name: Lateral Bound
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric movement emphasizing unilateral lateral power development, heavily recruiting the glutes, abductors, and quads while challenging frontal plane stability.

exercises.name: Depth Jump
exercises.description: An advanced plyometric exercise involving dropping from a height immediately followed by a maximal vertical jump. Emphasizes the stretch-shortening cycle to develop explosive power in the quads, glutes, and calves while placing high reactive forces on the lower body joints.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
exercises.description: An explosive plyometric exercise requiring rapid knee flexion toward the chest at the peak of a vertical jump, heavily recruiting the quads, hip flexors, and calves while generating high impact forces upon landing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge exercise performed with dumbbells held across the upper back, primarily targeting the hamstrings, glutes, and erector spinae. The movement involves forward flexion at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine against gravity.

exercises.name: Single-leg Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral hip-hinge movement performed with a barbell that challenges dynamic balance while targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and erector spinae. It places significant demand on the core and ankle stabilizers to maintain postural alignment throughout the range of motion.

exercises.name: Single-leg Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.description: A unilateral hip extension exercise performed with a barbell across the pelvis, leaning against a bench, targeting the glutes and hamstrings through a horizontal force vector.

exercises.name: Single-leg Hip Thrust (Bodyweight)
exercises.description: An unilateral hip extension exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings while utilizing bodyweight. The upper back rests on a bench while one leg drives through the floor, requiring significant core stabilization and single-leg stability.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Bodyweight)
exercises.description: A foundational lower-body exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings through hip extension while lying supine. Core and erector spinae stabilize the pelvis against lumbar hyperextension.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.description: A hip extension exercise utilizing a barbell placed across the hips to target the glutes and hamstrings through a shortened range of motion while lying supine.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.description: An effective hip-extension exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings, with a resistance band around the knees that actively engages the hip abductors to maintain knee alignment. Performed lying supine, it strengthens the posterior chain while minimizing lumbar spinal stress.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-through
exercises.description: A hip-hinge exercise performed with a low cable pulley that targets the glutes and hamstrings while minimizing lumbar stress through constant horizontal vector resistance.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.description: A quadruped bodyweight hip extension exercise that primarily targets the gluteus maximus while stabilizing the core and lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.description: A quadruped bodyweight exercise that targets the hip abductors and external rotators through hip abduction against gravity. It primarily strengthens the gluteus medius and minimus, making it effective for lateral pelvic stability.

exercises.name: Kickback Machine
exercises.description: An isolated hip extension exercise performed on a machine, primarily targeting the gluteus maximus against variable cable or lever resistance.

exercises.name: Glute Cable Kickback
exercises.description: An isolation exercise performed on a cable machine that targets the gluteus maximus through hip extension against horizontal resistance.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor Machine
exercises.description: A seated resistance exercise targeting the lateral hip muscles, primarily the gluteus medius and minimus, by driving the legs outward against padded levers.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor Machine
exercises.description: A seated resistance exercise targeting the adductor muscle group of the inner thigh by bringing the legs together against resistance. Primarily strengthens the adductors while engaging core and hip stabilizers.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Band)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a resistance band placed around the knees to strengthen the hip external rotators and abductors. The gluteus medius and minimus work to abduct and externally rotate the femur against the band's resistance while lying on the side.

exercises.name: Monster Walk (Band)
exercises.description: A lateral and forward movement exercise utilizing a resistance band placed around the legs to primarily target the hip abductors and external rotators against horizontal resistance.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.description: An effective hip abductor strengthening exercise performed by stepping sideways against the resistance of a mini-band placed around the legs. Primarily targets the gluteus medius and minimus to enhance hip stability and dynamic knee alignment.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A hip-hinge variation utilizing a wide stance and a dumbbell to target the glutes, quads, and adductors while minimizing lumbar stress through an upright torso.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift (Low Handle)
exercises.description: A compound lower-body exercise utilizing a hexagonal barbell that allows for a more upright torso compared to a straight bar, heavily recruiting the quads, glutes, and erector spinae while minimizing lumbar shear.

exercises.name: Stiff-leg Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement targeting the posterior chain, primarily loading the hamstrings and glutes through an eccentric stretch and concentric hip extension against gravity.

exercises.name: Kang Squat
exercises.description: A compound movement combining a good morning and a back squat, targeting the posterior chain, quadriceps, and erector spinae by challenging hip hinge and knee extension mechanics sequentially under load.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
exercises.description: An isolated machine-based exercise that targets the hamstrings through knee flexion while the user is seated, effectively minimizing lower back stress.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl (Assisted)
exercises.description: An eccentric-focused knee flexion exercise performed with anchored ankles, utilizing assistance to unload the movement, heavily targeting the hamstrings while requiring core and glute stabilization.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
exercises.description: A closed-chain hamstring and core exercise performed by curling a stability ball toward the glutes while bridging the hips. It heavily recruits the hamstrings, glutes, and erector spinae while requiring stabilization from the core and adductors.

exercises.name: Glute-ham Raise
exercises.description: An advanced posterior chain exercise where the hamstrings and glutes work dynamically through knee flexion and hip extension while stabilizing the spine.

exercises.name: Single-leg Stability Ball Leg Curl
exercises.description: An advanced hamstring and glute exercise performed by placing one heel on a stability ball, lifting the hips, and curling the ball toward the body. It heavily recruits the hamstrings for knee flexion while requiring intense core and glute stabilization to keep the hips elevated against gravity.

exercises.name: Cable Leg Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise utilizing a cable machine to perform knee flexion against resistance, primarily targeting the hamstrings and engaging the calves as secondary stabilizers.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: An isolated ankle plantar flexion exercise performed while seated to heavily target the soleus muscle, with secondary activation of the gastrocnemius and tibialis posterior.

exercises.name: Single-leg Calf Raise
exercises.description: An ankle-extension exercise performed on one leg that heavily targets the gastrocnemius and soleus through plantarflexion against gravity. It enhances ankle stability and lower leg strength.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.description: An ankle plantar flexion exercise performed on a leg press machine that primarily targets the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles against external resistance.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise targeting the anterior tibialis muscle by lifting the forefoot against gravity to strengthen ankle dorsiflexion and protect against shin splints.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.description: A bodyweight or weighted calf raise performed with a hip hinge posture, emphasizing maximum stretch and contraction of the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: A core stabilization exercise where the opposite arm and leg are lowered toward the floor while maintaining a neutral spine. It primarily targets the rectus abdominis and transverse abdominis while challenging anterior core strength and resisting lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: A quadruped core stability exercise that strengthens the erector spinae, glutes, and contralateral shoulder stabilizers through anti-rotation and anti-flexion mechanics.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: An advanced core strengthening exercise where the rolling wheel challenges the rectus abdominis and obliques to resist excessive lumbar extension while under a high anti-extension load.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.description: An advanced core strengthening exercise where the barbell is rolled forward from the knees, demanding high eccentric and isometric activation of the anterior core and lats to prevent lumbar hyperextension.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Rollout
exercises.description: An anti-extension core exercise performed by rolling a stability ball forward on the knees, heavily recruiting the rectus abdominis and deep core stabilizers while challenging shoulder flexion strength.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: An isometric core exercise that targets the rectus abdominis and deep stabilizing muscles by maintaining a lumbar flexion and posterior pelvic tilt against gravity.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description: An advanced core exercise popularized by Bruce Lee that requires the entire body to act as a rigid lever against gravity. It intensely recruits the rectus abdominis and obliques while heavily loading the hip flexors and upper body stabilizers.

exercises.name: Pike Hold (Rings)
exercises.description: An advanced isometric core and upper body hold performed on gymnastics rings where the body is suspended in a deep pike position. This primarily challenges the rectus abdominis, hip flexors, and anterior deltoids while demanding intense scapular depression and core compression.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core exercise that targets the rectus abdominis, transverse abdominis, and obliques, while engaging the shoulders and hips to maintain a stable, neutral spine against gravity.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.description: An anti-rotation core exercise performed from a high plank position, requiring unilateral stabilization of the shoulder girdle and core musculature to prevent pelvic and trunk rotation.

exercises.name: RKC Plank
exercises.description: An intense isometric core exercise that maximizes total body tension by driving the elbows down and squeezing the glutes and quads. This recruits the entire anterior core and surrounding musculature to resist spinal extension and pelvic tilt.

exercises.name: Long-lever Plank
exercises.description: An advanced isometric core exercise where the elbows are moved forward relative to the shoulders, creating a longer moment arm that significantly increases demands on the rectus abdominis, transverse abdominis, and anti-extension stabilizers.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch (Kneeling)
exercises.description: A spinal flexion exercise utilizing a cable pulley to target the rectus abdominis against variable resistance. It loads the core dynamically while requiring stabilization from the hip flexors and upper body.

exercises.name: Machine Crunch
exercises.description: A seated abdominal flexion exercise performed on a weighted machine, focusing heavily on the rectus abdominis through spinal flexion against resistance.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.description: An abdominal exercise performed on a decline bench that increases the range of motion and gravitational resistance, primarily targeting the rectus abdominis through spinal flexion.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
exercises.description: An advanced core exercise where a resistance weight is held against the chest during spinal flexion, primarily targeting the rectus abdominis through concentric contraction.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.description: An abdominal exercise performed lying supine on the floor, targeting the lower rectus abdominis and hip flexors by lifting the legs against gravity while stabilizing the lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.description: An abdominal exercise performed by lifting the pelvis and lower back off the floor, targeting the rectus abdominis with heavy emphasis on the lower fibers and hip flexors.

exercises.name: V-up
exercises.description: An advanced bodyweight core exercise that simultaneously flexes the hips and spine against gravity, heavily recruiting the rectus abdominis and hip flexors.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit-up
exercises.description: A dynamic core exercise where the upper body and legs simultaneously flex upward to meet in the middle, targeting the rectus abdominis and hip flexors against gravity.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: A dynamic core exercise targeting the rectus abdominis and obliques through simultaneous spinal flexion and contralateral trunk rotation.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
exercises.description: A dynamic core and hip-flexor endurance exercise performed lying supine, which recruits the rectus abdominis, hip flexors, and quads while requiring deep lumbar stabilization against gravity.

exercises.name: Toes to Bar
exercises.description: An advanced core and upper body exercise where the hanging body flexes at the hips and spine to bring the toes to touch the pull-up bar. Primarily targets the rectus abdominis and hip flexors while demanding strong grip and lat engagement.

exercises.name: L-sit (Parallel bars)
exercises.description: An advanced isometric core and upper body hold performed on parallel bars, requiring intense activation of the rectus abdominis, hip flexors, and triceps to keep the legs elevated horizontally and the body supported.

exercises.name: L-sit (Floor)
exercises.description: An advanced isometric bodyweight hold requiring extreme core compression and shoulder depression to elevate the pelvis and legs off the ground. It heavily engages the rectus abdominis, hip flexors, anterior deltoids, and triceps while maintaining a hollow-body position.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
exercises.description: An anti-rotation core exercise performed by pressing a cable handle away from the chest, challenging the obliques and transverse abdominis to resist trunk rotation.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band)
exercises.description: An anti-rotation core exercise performed with a resistance band, primarily targeting the obliques and transverse abdominis to resist trunk rotation and flexion.

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.description: A rotational core exercise performed with a barbell anchored in a landmine sleeve, training the obliques and transverse abdominis to resist and produce rotational force.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop (High to Low)
exercises.description: A rotational core exercise performed with a cable machine where movement originates from high to low, targeting the obliques and transverse abdominis while integrating shoulder and hip rotation.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop (Low to High)
exercises.description: A rotational core exercise performed on a cable machine that trains diagonal force production, heavily recruiting the obliques and transverse abdominis while integrating shoulder and hip rotation.

exercises.name: Rotational Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.description: A high-power explosive movement that trains rotational core strength, obliques, and total-body power transfer by forcefully slamming a medicine ball down to the ground. It requires coordinated force production from the lower extremities through the trunk and upper body.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core exercise that primarily targets the obliques and transverse abdominis to resist lateral trunk flexion and stabilize the spine.

exercises.name: Side Plank with Hip Dip
exercises.description: An isometric core and stabilization exercise that adds dynamic adduction and abduction of the hip to target the obliques, gluteus medius, and quadratus lumborum under lateral loading.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.description: An advanced isometric core and hip adduction exercise where the top leg rests on a bench while the body is held in a side plank, heavily engaging the adductors, obliques, and lateral stabilizers.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An asymmetrical loaded carry that targets core lateral stabilization, grip strength, and upper traps. By holding a heavy dumbbell in one hand, the body must resist lateral flexion, intensely recruiting the contralateral obliques and ipsilateral grip and core stabilizers.

exercises.name: Farmers Walk (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A dynamic loaded carry exercise that challenges total-body stability, grip strength, and core bracing against gravity while walking.

exercises.name: Farmers Walk (Trap bar)
exercises.description: A loaded carry exercise utilizing a trap bar that primarily challenges grip strength, core stability, and the upper back, while recruiting the entire lower body and postural chain to ambulate under heavy load.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.description: An isometric posterior chain exercise where the arms and legs are lifted off the ground, heavily recruiting the erector spinae, glutes, and upper back extensors to combat gravity.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Hyperextension bench)
exercises.description: An effective posterior chain exercise performed on a hyperextension bench that targets the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings through lumbar and hip extension against gravity.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.description: An open-chain posterior chain exercise performed on a specialized bench, targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and erector spinae by extending the hips against resistance.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl
exercises.description: A spinal mobility and strength exercise performed by sequentially flexing the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar spine while holding a light weight, strongly targeting the posterior chain and spinal erectors through a full flexed range of motion.

exercises.name: Seated Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed in a seated position with a barbell across the upper back, targeting the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings while minimizing lower body stability demands.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.description: An explosive full-body movement that transitions a barbell from the floor to the shoulders in one swift motion, heavily recruiting the triple extension muscles of the lower body and upper back.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean
exercises.description: An explosive total-body movement initiating from the hang position, requiring triple extension of the hips, knees, and ankles to drive the barbell upward before catching it in a partial squat. It heavily targets the posterior chain, upper back, and traps while developing explosive power.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.description: An explosive total-body exercise where a barbell is pulled from the floor to overhead in one continuous motion, caught in a partial squat. It heavily recruits the posterior chain, traps, shoulders, and core for speed and power development.

exercises.name: Hang Power Snatch
exercises.description: An explosive total-body power exercise where a barbell is accelerated from the hang position overhead in one motion, catching it in a partial squat. Heavily recruits the posterior chain, upper back, and shoulders while developing explosive triple extension of the hips, knees, and ankles.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
exercises.description: A explosive full-body Olympic weightlifting movement that transitions a barbell from the floor to the shoulders in a clean, then overhead in a jerk. Highly recruits the entire lower body, core, upper back, and shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Thruster
exercises.description: A compound full-body exercise combining a front squat with an overhead press, powerfully recruiting the lower body, core, and shoulders to move a barbell from the rack position to overhead against gravity.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.description: A compound full-body movement combining a front squat with an overhead press, driving power from the lower body through the core and upper body to push dumbbells against gravity.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster
exercises.description: A compound full-body exercise combining a front squat and an overhead press, effectively driving force from the lower body through the core and into the upper body. It heavily engages the quads, glutes, shoulders, and triceps while requiring substantial core and spinal stabilization.

exercises.name: Push Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: An explosive compound exercise utilizing a slight knee dip and drive to assist the shoulders and triceps in pressing dumbbells overhead. This movement heavily engages the quads, glutes, and shoulders while requiring robust core stabilization.

exercises.name: Push Jerk
exercises.description: An explosive multi-joint power exercise where a slight dip and drive from the lower body propels a barbell overhead. Primarily targets the shoulders, triceps, quads, and glutes while requiring intense core stabilization.

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.description: An explosive compound lift where force is driven from the lower body through the hips and shoulders to lock the weight overhead, requiring extensive muscular coordination across the entire body.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (Two-handed)
exercises.description: An explosive hip hinge movement driven by the glutes and hamstrings to propel the kettlebell outward, heavily utilizing the posterior chain and core for stabilization against momentum.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (Single-handed)
exercises.description: An explosive hip-hinge movement that develops posterior chain power and unilateral core stability. The hamstrings, glutes, and erector spinae drive the explosive upward swing, while the upper back and single arm resist rotational forces.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.description: An explosive hip hinge movement that rapidly accelerates a kettlebell from between the legs to the rack position. It heavily recruits the posterior chain, glutes, hamstrings, and upper back while demanding dynamic core stabilization.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Press
exercises.description: An overhead pressing variation performed with a kettlebell, where the offset load challenges stability, heavily recruiting the anterior deltoids, triceps, and core musculature.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.description: An explosive, full-body power movement where a kettlebell is pulled from between the legs to overhead in a single continuous motion, heavily recruiting posterior chain muscles and core stabilizers while requiring high shoulder stability.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.description: A foundational lower body squat variation where a kettlebell is held vertically against the chest, heavily recruiting the quads and glutes while engaging the upper back and core to maintain an upright torso.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement pattern focusing on eccentric loading of the posterior chain, primarily targeting the glutes and hamstrings while utilizing the erector spinae for isometric spinal stability.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure-8
exercises.description: A dynamic rotational movement where a kettlebell is passed in a figure-eight pattern between the legs, primarily engaging the core, obliques, and hip stabilizers while challenging grip strength and coordination.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.description: A complex full-body movement transitioning from supine to standing while holding a weight overhead, heavily engaging the core, shoulders, and hips through a multi-planar stability challenge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.description: A complex mobility and stability exercise that requires thoracic rotation and lateral flexion under load, heavily targeting the obliques, glutes, and shoulder stabilizers.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.description: A dynamic shoulder mobility and core stability exercise where the kettlebell is circled closely around the head. This movement heavily recruits the shoulders, upper back, and rotator cuff while challenging anti-rotation core strength.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: A high-intensity full-body calisthenic exercise that transitions from a standing position to a plank, push-up, and explosive vertical jump. It heavily taxes the cardiovascular system while recruiting the entire musculoskeletal system against gravity.

exercises.name: Burpee Box Jump
exercises.description: A high-intensity plyometric exercise combining a horizontal push-up with a powerful vertical jump onto a box, engaging the entire body and heavily taxing the cardiovascular system.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.description: A dynamic bodyweight core and conditioning exercise that involves alternating hip and knee flexion from a plank position. It heavily recruits the anterior core, hip flexors, and shoulder stabilizers while elevating heart rate.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.description: A quadrupedal locomotion exercise that builds core stability, shoulder endurance, and total-body coordination by demanding continuous anti-rotation and force transfer across the kinetic chain.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.description: A bodyweight movement pattern that transitions from a standing position to a high plank and back, actively engaging the anterior core, shoulders, and hamstrings through dynamic stretching and stabilization.

exercises.name: Man-maker (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A compound full-body exercise combining a push-up, single-arm renegade row, clean, squat, and overhead press, heavily taxing the core, upper body, and lower body musculature.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.description: A dynamic plank-based pulling movement that challenges core stability while unilaterally loading the upper back and arms. The lats, rhomboids, and traps act as primary movers for the row while the abs, obliques, and shoulder stabilizers work intensely to prevent torso rotation.

exercises.name: Devil Press
exercises.description: A high-intensity functional movement combining a burpee and a double dumbbell snatch. This full-body exercise heavily recruits the posterior chain, shoulders, and core while challenging cardiovascular capacity.

exercises.name: Overhead Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: A loaded carry variation where dumbbells are held overhead with locked elbows, challenging core stability, shoulder joint integrity, and upper body postural control against gravity while walking.

exercises.name: Waiter Walk
exercises.description: An overhead unilateral carry exercise that challenges core stability, shoulder stability, and scapular upward rotation while resisting lateral trunk flexion.

exercises.name: Yoke Carry
exercises.description: A dynamic loaded carry where a heavy yoke is supported across the upper back, challenging spinal erectors, core stability, and total-body muscular endurance against heavy axial compression.

exercises.name: Zercher Carry
exercises.description: A loaded carry variation where a barbell is held in the crooks of the elbows, heavily loading the upper back, biceps, and core while requiring an upright torso against spinal flexion moments.

exercises.name: Barbell Clean and Press
exercises.description: A compound explosive movement starting with a triple extension hip hinge to pull the barbell to the shoulders, followed by an overhead press. It heavily recruits the full body, particularly the posterior chain, quads, shoulders, and core.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip High Pull
exercises.description: An explosive total-body movement utilizing a wide snatch grip to target the posterior chain, traps, and upper back through triple extension of the hips, knees, and ankles followed by an aggressive high pull of the arms.

exercises.name: Hip 90-90 Stretch
exercises.description: A mobility exercise where both knees are bent at 90-degree angles on the floor to target internal and external hip rotation, working the hip rotators and glutes while improving joint range of motion.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.description: A classic yoga stretch targeting the external rotators and glutes of the front leg and the hip flexors of the rear leg to improve hip mobility.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.description: A dynamic full-body mobility exercise combining a deep lunge, thoracic rotation, and hamstring stretch to target the hips, thoracic spine, and core.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
exercises.description: A mobility exercise focusing on rotational movement through the thoracic spine while stabilizing the lumbar region. It primarily engages the obliques and erector spinae to drive and control rotation.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.description: A spinal mobility exercise that alternates between spinal flexion (Cat) and extension (Cow), actively recruiting the erector spinae, abs, and obliques to improve segmental range of motion.

exercises.name: Glute Stretch (Figure-4)
exercises.description: A static mobility stretch targeting the gluteal complex and deep hip external rotators. It lengthens the gluteus maximus and piriformis by crossing one ankle over the opposite knee and drawing the leg toward the chest.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch (Lying)
exercises.description: A passive flexibility exercise where the leg is elevated while lying supine to elongate the hamstring muscles and improve posterior chain mobility.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretching exercise targeting the iliopsoas and rectus femoris of the rear leg by placing the hips into extension and knee into flexion.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch (Doorway)
exercises.description: A static stretch performed in a doorway to elongate the latissimus dorsi and shoulder girdle musculature. It places minimal activation on muscles and is utilized for improving overhead mobility and reducing tissue tension.

exercises.name: Chest Opener Stretch
exercises.description: A static stretching exercise where arms are drawn back behind the torso to elongate the pectoral muscles and anterior deltoids, promoting shoulder mobility and relieving anterior chest tightness.

exercises.name: Band Dislocate
exercises.description: A shoulder mobility exercise where a resistance band is held with a wide grip and passed overhead and behind the back. It actively targets the rotator cuff, posterior deltoids, and upper back musculature while dynamically stretching the chest and anterior shoulders.

exercises.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation Stretch
exercises.description: A mobility exercise designed to stretch the external rotators and posterior capsule of the shoulder joint by applying gentle internal rotation force.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.description: An upper body corrective exercise where the arms slide up and down a wall, targeting the lower and middle traps, serratus anterior, and rotator cuff while promoting scapular upward rotation.

exercises.name: Serratus Wall Slide
exercises.description: An upper body mobility and stability exercise where forearms slide up a wall, targeting the serratus anterior and lower traps for scapular upward rotation and protraction.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Circle
exercises.description: An open-chain hip mobility exercise performed on hands and knees that strengthens the glutes, abductors, and hip flexors through circumduction. It targets the hip capsule and surrounding musculature to improve range of motion and joint stability.

exercises.name: Squat to Stand
exercises.description: A dynamic mobility exercise where the practitioner folds forward to stretch the hamstrings, then drops into a deep squat while elevating the chest, primarily recruiting the quads, glutes, and erector spinae while challenging ankle and hip mobility.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.description: A joint mobility exercise that involves rotating the ankle through its full range of motion to improve joint health, flexibility, and neuromuscular control.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch (Wall)
exercises.description: A static stretch targeting the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles of the lower leg by placing hands against a wall and stepping one foot back with the knee straight or bent.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed with a barbell across the upper back, targeting the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings through lumbar and hip flexion under axial load.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
exercises.description: An elbow-flexion exercise performed with a pronated grip that emphasizes the brachialis, brachioradialis, and forearm extensors while challenging grip strength and elbow stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed with dumbbells held across the upper back or shoulders, heavily loading the hamstrings, glutes, and erector spinae against gravity through trunk flexion and extension.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core exercise that targets the rectus abdominis, transverse abdominis, and obliques, requiring stabilization across the entire kinetic chain against gravity.

exercises.name: Seated Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed in a seated position with a barbell across the upper back, targeting the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings while minimizing lower body stability demands.

exercises.name: Clean and Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: An explosive full-body compound movement combining a power clean from the floor with an overhead press, targeting the lower body, core, upper back, and shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed with a barbell across the upper back, heavily targeting the hamstrings, glutes, and erector spinae through posterior chain hip flexion and extension.

exercises.name: 21s (Barbell Curl)
exercises.description: A variation of the barbell curl performed in three distinct ranges of motion (7 bottom-half reps, 7 top-half reps, and 7 full reps) to maximize muscular tension and metabolic stress on the biceps and forearms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Good Morning
exercises.description: A hip-hinge movement performed with dumbbells held across the upper back, targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and erector spinae. It places significant demand on the posterior chain to decelerate and reverse torso flexion against gravity.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core strengthening exercise that engages the anterior chain, utilizing the rectus abdominis and transverse abdominis to resist spinal extension against gravity.

exercises.name: Seated Good Morning
exercises.description: A seated variation of the good morning that isolates the posterior chain and spinal erectors by eliminating hip and knee joint contributions from the lower legs. Flexion and extension occur primarily at the hip joint while maintaining a neutral spine against gravity.

exercises.name: 45-degree Back Extension
exercises.description: An extension exercise performed on a 45-degree hyperextension bench that targets the erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings through hip and lumbar extension against gravity.
